defect: Mastra Code's observational-memory observer call completing mid-turn makes mastracode end the active ACP prompt with stopReason 'cancelled', drop its in-flight model request and exit the ACP server process, losing the user's task and all later steps of the session.
expected_behavior: Finish every turn; a background observational-memory observer call must not end the active ACP prompt or terminate the ACP server.
observed_behavior: Reproduced in both rounds on 4206a2f7fe08: an OM observer response completed and within 0.5-0.7 s mastracode dropped its main model request, ended the prompt as cancelled and closed the ACP adapter (R1 at step-5, R2 at step-9).

Judge issue is only about npm registry access.
